data.one_liner: A modern design system component library built on Naked UI and Mix.
data.what_it_does: Remix combines headless UI behavior with a chainable styling system to provide customizable widgets and the prebuilt Fortal design system. It handles complex component states like hover, focus, and press alongside layout and overlays.
use_when: You need custom design system components with complete styling freedom.
You want built-in interaction states like hover, focus, and press without boilerplate.
You want to use prebuilt design tokens and components based on Radix principles.
avoid_when: You prefer standard Material or Cupertino widgets without custom styling engines.
You do not want additional styling dependencies like Mix in your project.
strengths: Comprehensive set of production-ready components and input elements.
Chainable, expressive styling API with robust state handling.
Includes the prebuilt Fortal Design System based on Radix tokens.
weaknesses: Requires learning a custom styling API built on top of Mix.
Adds extra architectural complexity compared to standard Flutter widgets.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard Google Material Design components instead of a custom styling engine library.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building an iOS-styled app using native Cupertino widgets.
